author: National Geographic
description: Africa's Okavango River Basin supplies water across three countries, helping to sustain a million people. A commitment to safeguarding the source of the river basin in Angola lives on through the Okavango Eternal Partnership between @debeers and National Geographic. Recently, the Angolan wetland area where the source waters originate was designated a Ramsar Wetland of International importance, the culmination of decades of conservation work. This is a vital step in helping to secure and preserve these vital headwaters, a complex biological lifeline, for many generations to come.
